name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key, then open the door and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard requires the box; Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) with that existence impose both stated orders (ball before key, door before box) — the Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) clause records the task's stated ball-before-key order. Together they force the ball, key, and door in order without redundant Existence clauses.

texts: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key.
Open the door before picking up the box.
Eventually pick up the target box.
